g.title: EleanorRank6Convo9 begins.
g.text: EleanorRank6Convo9 begins.

g.title: j3949557396
g.text: So what's a 'Mara Lohk' when it's at home, as my mum would have put it?

g.title: j3354949159
g.text: It's what the Indifference calls me.

g.title: j3941072074
g.text: I don't know. It's Voidtongue.

g.title: j2262491992
g.text: Ah. Because I hear it in my head sometimes, very faintly, when I look at you.

g.title: j1403727449
g.text: Check boolean EleanorDating

g.title: j1383382543
g.text: (Along with other things like 'phwoar' and 'bloody hell' and 'that's MY Drifter, that is.)

g.title: j1403727449->j1383382543
g.text: true

g.title: j245936942
g.text: (Along with other things like 'damn, they're cool' and 'that's my mate, that is'.)

g.title: j1403727449->j245936942
g.text: false

g.title: j129761338
g.text: Are there any words in this language that you DO know?

g.title: j991064749
g.text: A few.

g.title: j68663857
g.text: Netra is 'Decay', Xata is 'Truth', Ris is 'Light'...

g.title: j592629880
g.text: Lohk is 'Void', Oull is 'Possibility', Khra is 'Time'...

g.title: j960136630
g.text: Good luck making a fridge magnet poem with those

g.title: j3316654915
g.text: Hang on. If 'Lohk' is Void, then a Mara Lohk is a Something Void. Or a Void Something.

g.title: j3912187269
g.text: Void Mare? Nightmare? Void devil?

g.title: j3238229925
g.text: Be careful. It's more than just a language.

g.title: j2523987931
g.text: I've been called worse.

g.title: j3086936277
g.text: Is this the moment when I look over my shoulder and see a black-eyed Eleanor grinning back at me?

g.title: j3333825867
g.text: Don't be surprised if I come back and nag you about this more.

g.title: j1541369274
g.text: I think I'll take a little look just to be sure....

g.title: j933361874
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2195877298
g.text: OMFL

g.title: j2205358657
g.text: Can't help prying. It's the journalist in me.

g.title: j708984062
g.text: What?

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j2810627241
g.text: Spider

g.title: j3188859804
g.text: Seriously?

g.title: j2409913288
g.text: I was all set to joke with you about how there was sod all there but there was a bastard great spider dangling from the ceiling

g.title: j564543304
g.text: talk later, need to get a glass and a bit of card
